definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transition_reservation_to_rotation(p_reservation_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
  v_ctx jsonb;
  v_res public.reservations%rowtype;
  v_session public.parking_sessions%rowtype;
  v_rotation public.rotation_sessions%rowtype;
  v_tariff public.rotation_tariffs%rowtype;
  v_vehicle_code text;
  v_tariff_code text;
begin
  v_ctx := public.rotation_operator_context();

  select *
  into v_res
  from public.reservations
  where id=p_reservation_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Reserva no encontrada';
  end if;

  select code
  into v_vehicle_code
  from public.vehicle_types
  where id=v_res.vehicle_type_id;

  if v_res.status='cancelled' then
    raise exception 'La reserva está cancelada';
  end if;

  if v_now <= v_res.exit_at then
    raise exception 'La estancia todavía no ha finalizado';
  end if;

  if v_res.rotation_pending and v_res.rotation_session_id is not null then
    select *
    into v_rotation
    from public.rotation_sessions
    where id=v_res.rotation_session_id;

    if found and v_rotation.status='inside' then
      return jsonb_build_object(
        'ok',true,
        'already_created',true,
        'rotation_session_id',v_rotation.id,
        'ticket_number',v_rotation.ticket_number,
        'plate',v_rotation.plate,
        'entry_at',v_rotation.entry_at,
        'event_at',v_now
      );
    end if;
  end if;

  select *
  into v_session
  from public.parking_sessions
  where reservation_id=p_reservation_id
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1
  for update;

  if not found or v_session.status <> 'inside' then
    raise exception 'El vehículo no consta actualmente dentro en Estancias';
  end if;

  if exists(
    select 1
    from public.rotation_sessions rs
    where upper(rs.plate)=upper(v_res.plate)
      and rs.status='inside'
  ) then
    raise exception 'El vehículo ya tiene una estancia activa en Rotación';
  end if;

  v_tariff_code := case upper(coalesce(v_vehicle_code,''))
    when 'MOTO' then 'MOTO'
    when 'TURISMO' then 'TURISMO'
    when 'XL' then 'COCHERA'
    when 'XXL' then 'CAMION'
    else 'TURISMO'
  end;

  select *
  into v_tariff
  from public.rotation_tariffs
  where code=v_tariff_code
    and active=true
    and calculation_ready=true;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'No existe tarifa de Rotación configurada para este vehículo';
  end if;

  insert into public.rotation_sessions(
    tariff_id,
    plate,
    client_text,
    authorized_text,
    leaves_keys,
    key_number,
    entry_at,
    status,
    entry_user_id,
    entry_employee_name,
    entry_shift_id,
    entry_shift_code,
    entry_shift_date,
    source_reservation_id,
    billing_only
  )
  values(
    v_tariff.id,
    upper(trim(v_res.plate)),
    nullif(trim(concat_ws(' · ',v_res.customer_name,v_res.customer_phone)),''),
    null,
    false,
    null,
    v_res.exit_at,
    'inside',
    (v_ctx->>'user_id')::uuid,
    v_ctx->>'employee_name',
    nullif(v_ctx->>'shift_id','')::uuid,
    nullif(v_ctx->>'shift_code','')::smallint,
    (v_ctx->>'shift_date')::date,
    v_res.id,
    true
  )
  returning *
  into v_rotation;

  insert into public.parking_events(
    session_id,event_type,event_at,old_spot_id,created_by,note
  )
  values(
    v_session.id,
    'check_out',
    v_now,
    v_session.spot_id,
    auth.uid(),
    'Fin de Estancias y traspaso a Rotación pendiente de cobro'
  );

  update public.parking_sessions
  set status='departed',
      actual_exit_at=v_now,
      updated_at=v_now
  where id=v_session.id;

  update public.reservations
  set rotation_pending=true,
      rotation_session_id=v_rotation.id,
      updated_at=v_now
  where id=v_res.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'already_created',false,
    'reservation_id',v_res.id,
    'rotation_session_id',v_rotation.id,
    'ticket_number',v_rotation.ticket_number,
    'plate',v_rotation.plate,
    'tariff_code',v_tariff.code,
    'entry_at',v_rotation.entry_at,
    'event_at',v_now
  );
end
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_available_spaces(p_vehicle_type_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_exclude_reservation_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
with compatible as (select * from public.parking_spots where active and inventory_state='available' and (p_vehicle_type_id is null or polyvalent or vehicle_type_id=p_vehicle_type_id)),
points as (select p_start t union select entry_at from public.reservations where entry_at>=p_start and entry_at<p_end union select starts_at from public.capacity_blocks where active and starts_at>=p_start and starts_at<p_end),
counts as (select t,
(select count(*) from compatible p where not exists(select 1 from public.capacity_blocks b where b.active and b.spot_id=p.id and b.starts_at<=t and b.ends_at>t)
and not exists(select 1 from public.parking_sessions s where s.spot_id=p.id and s.status='inside' and s.reservation_id is distinct from p_exclude_reservation_id and (s.planned_exit_at is null or s.planned_exit_at>t))
and not exists(select 1 from public.reservations r where r.assigned_spot_id=p.id and r.id is distinct from p_exclude_reservation_id and r.entry_at<=t and r.exit_at>t and (r.status in ('confirmed','checked_in') or (r.status='pending_payment' and r.expires_at>now()))))
- (select count(*) from public.reservations r where (p_vehicle_type_id is null or r.vehicle_type_id=p_vehicle_type_id) and (r.assigned_spot_id is null or exists(select 1 from public.parking_spots l where l.id=r.assigned_spot_id and l.inventory_state='legacy')) and r.id is distinct from p_exclude_reservation_id and r.entry_at<=t and r.exit_at>t and (r.status in ('confirmed','checked_in') or (r.status='pending_payment' and r.expires_at>now())))
- coalesce((select sum(blocked_spaces) from public.capacity_blocks b where b.active and b.spot_id is null and (p_vehicle_type_id is null or b.vehicle_type_id=p_vehicle_type_id) and b.starts_at<=t and b.ends_at>t),0) available from points)
select greatest(0,coalesce(min(available),0))::integer from counts;$function$
